name: Service desk import: applications (TOPdesk)
description: Reads the application records from the service desk and creates or updates the supplier, the application and your organisation's use of it. Matches on the service desk record first, then on name and supplier. On an update it writes only the fields the service desk owns.

name: Service desk import: relations (TOPdesk)
description: TOPdesk lists the links of one asset at a time, so this import asks for the links of every application in use that came from TOPdesk, and records each as a connection between the applications. A link whose other end is not imported yet waits for the next run.

name: Service desk import: licences (TOPdesk)
description: Reads licences or contracts from the service desk and records them on the application in use they belong to. A new one is created with every field; after that stackiq owns its licence and contract fields, and the import only refreshes the service desk reference.

name: Service desk import: contracts (TOPdesk)
description: Reads licences or contracts from the service desk and records them on the application in use they belong to. A new one is created with every field; after that stackiq owns its licence and contract fields, and the import only refreshes the service desk reference.

name: Service desk export: applications in use (TOPdesk)
description: Sends an application in use to the service desk when stackiq-owned fields change: licences, contract, BBN level, TIME class and publication. A record the service desk does not know yet is created there with every field, and its record id comes back. A change the import wrote is not sent back.

name: File import: applications
description: Imports applications from an uploaded CSV or XLSX file through the same mapping and matching as the service desk import. Importing the same file again updates rather than duplicates.
